run.name: Kodiak Gas Services, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (KGS)
run.summary: Kodiak is a contract compression credit with contracted revenue and liquidity of USD 1,742.0 million, but leverage of 3.63x is no longer falling quickly because power growth spending outruns cash flow; funding and execution of that build decide the outcome. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 2,780,917 over LTM adjusted EBITDA 766,091; cash 137,553; excludes acquired power EBITDA before April 1, 2026 so leverage is overstated against a pro forma perimeter (pro forma EBITDA Not calculable); management reports 3.2x and 3.1x netting all cash on a covenant basis (release 2026-08-06 page:5)

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM adjusted EBITDA 766,091 over LTM cash interest 185,176 (FY2025 plus H1 2026 103,535 less H1 2025 87,075); the ABL covenant minimum is 2.5x on a defined basis not supplied

cash.basis: Cash. Commitments 2,000,000 less drawn 380,917 less letters of credit 14,600 (10-Q 2026-06-30 page:20-21); company states $1.6 billion available and $1.7 billion total liquidity (page:48; release 2026-08-06 page:5); the ABL matures September 5, 2030, so no facility expires within twelve months; borrowing base not supplied

cashflow.basis: Operating cash flow, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant definitions, executed financing documents and power customer contracts are not supplied, so covenant headroom and power revenue visibility cannot be tested.

CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA omits the acquired power business before April 2026, and covenant definitions are not supplied, so the 3.2x covenant leverage reported by management cannot be recomputed.
